en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small town nestled in rolling hills and fields. In the foreground are a few large buildings and scattered houses, while the middle ground shows a compact town with many gabled roofs and a prominent church tower. Forested hills rise in the background, with one hilltop bearing a structure or lookout. Printed text in German appears along the top margin, identifying the location and elevation.
